_comment: Candidate creature models, OFF by default (scripts/creatures/creature_species.gd _apply_model_flags). An enabled flag merges its per-species placeholder overrides (model, colourway_source_species, animations, ...) over species.json; keys starting with _ are notes. The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled. Owner-picked remakes 1 Nov 2026: one flag per species so each closes on its own verdict.

remake_owner1101_terrapup._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov 2026: lean rottweiler-like large dog, mossy stone plates on spine and head, jade eyes (Meshy 01a197b4-5a12-7537-a376-2d571177853a). Ground patch stripped, dog3 rig recipe at the established 3.20 m, dog3 clip author (every gameplay role), jade-eye emission. Provenance: assets/creatures/tetherbound/terrapup/candidate_owner1101/source/provenance.json.
